text: Name an LLM inference or serving engine
note: Software that runs or serves LLMs: datacenter servers, local runners, on-device runtimes and research serving systems

answers.q: Run 100B+ models BitTorrent-style, with the layers spread across volunteers' GPUs.
Put prefill and decode on different GPUs. The paper that made disaggregation the default idea.
Moonshot's KV-cache-centric disaggregated architecture behind Kimi.
Karpathy's Llama 2 inference in one file of pure C.
PyTorch's proof that plain torch.compile plus quantization can be fast, in under 1,000 lines.
Runs DeepSeek-scale MoEs on one GPU plus lots of CPU RAM by offloading the experts.
Pool your laptops, phones and Macs into one cluster and run a big model at home.
InternLM's toolkit. Its TurboMind engine descends from FasterTransformer.
NVIDIA's CUDA kernels for transformer inference, and TensorRT-LLM's predecessor.
PygmalionAI's vLLM-based engine, built to serve many roleplay chats at once.
OSDI '22's iteration-level scheduling: the paper that gave us continuous batching.
Serves thousands of LoRA adapters off one base model with unified paging.
Hot neurons stay on the GPU, cold ones run on the CPU.
High-throughput generation on a single GPU by offloading to CPU memory and disk.
Hugging Face's Rust-and-Python server. Went to a custom license in 2023, then back to Apache 2.0.
NVIDIA's model server for any framework. Not to be confused with OpenAI's Triton language.
A desktop app for downloading and chatting with local GGUF and MLX models.
Apple's array framework built on unified memory; mlx-lm serves LLMs on Macs.
Fast consumer-GPU inference with the mixed-bit EXL2 format.
Compiles models with Apache TVM to run on phones, browsers and GPUs alike.
One file runs on six operating systems, thanks to Cosmopolitan Libc's polyglot binaries.
RadixAttention shares KV cache across requests via a radix tree of prefixes. The name everyone drops after vLLM.
PagedAttention: the KV cache managed like virtual memory pages. Born at Berkeley.
Georgi Gerganov's March 2023 hack that put LLaMA on a MacBook. Now runs on nearly anything.
llama.cpp under a Docker-style CLI and model registry: ollama run llama3.
